player_bounds.rule: e = (playerX - D174) AND $FF; e < $10 -> X := cam+$10 (minus this update's X speed), X speed := 0; e >= $F8 -> X := cam+$F7 (same compensation)
player_bounds.scope: UNCONDITIONAL: not owned by the sign, a boss or any object. Proven with a bare limit lock (D280 = D282 = camera) and no object: data/t2/clamp-scope.json

player_bounds.reads: the COMMITTED camera D174, so it uses the previous update's camera exactly as a Z80-ordered POC step would
player_bounds.widescreen_form: EDGE(LEFT,+16) .. EDGE(RIGHT,-9) of the live view, full-width integers (the 8-bit low-byte form teleports a player at d >= 256: do not port it)

legitimate_off_screen_phases: player state $20 (act-clear run-off): flag at EDGE(RIGHT,+33)
player states >= $29 (the clamp is skipped by the ROM gate)
EEZ tube states $16/$17 and other scripted transports (own handlers)
update_order: ROM $16B8: camera ($16CA) -> player ($16CD) -> objects ($16D0). The player clamp therefore reads the camera committed by the PREVIOUS update; POC order (adapter step, objects phase, then zone End Step camera) has the same relation.
